blocks.content: I started to make a new game :o. It will be Spooky game im planing to release it in early 2027 like january. It will be topdown horror game with a fun mechanic like fnaf. So you can be REALly suck at game or you can grind like Esport player. I bet there will be speedruners :D. Game will be located in anantha town well this place is special for us its our first game idea ever, in 2025 My frends and i decided to make a retro 3d game but things didnt work well so end of the day What I got is bunch of ideas and larping. So I was thinkg about making a fun game but also Spooky and complex story so i ended up in making a game staged in a highschool called anatha academy. Thats all for today i will make more entrys in future.

Well Im BACK! I have been working on Art, Systems, story and lots of things. Firstly I found a really good and free asset pack I had to modify it to suit my art but its a very good asset pack overall i will leave the link also i will add the credits to original creator when i release the game for sure. About interaction system, its pretty basic stuff compared to inventory system well there will be inventory system in the game but it will be very basic and probably No UI for inventory so basicly you will be able to carry 1 item at the moment or i wont add inventory havent decided yet. Back to interaction system i added sitting chair mechanic that red square that you see is for debuging dont mind it i also worked on lighting stuff found it pretty easy so development is going very well but project started to become a little bit complicated Im planing to make a Interaction Extension + object To make things 100times easier. Also I share more screenshots and art works at discord server so you mind checking there if ur interested. About story i dont want to spoil you but we got a FREAKINSTEIN teacher very gross disturbing science teacher I cant imageine what prime dave whould do to him :D
